expectations.name: legacy_client
expectations.requirement: Existing event types remain accepted when the summary event is absent.

expectations.name: capability_absent
expectations.requirement: The client emits no summary unless hosted acceptance names the exact schema, capability version, and fixture-manifest digest.

expectations.name: capability_mismatch
expectations.requirement: A schema, capability-version, or fixture-manifest digest mismatch disables emission and preserves local-only operation.

expectations.name: rollback
expectations.requirement: Client rollback stops new emission and does not delete or reinterpret accepted rows.

expectations.name: tenant_isolation
expectations.requirement: Authenticated tenant binding, not payload routing fields, scopes repository identity; equal repo slugs in two tenants remain isolated.

expectations.name: export
expectations.requirement: Export returns each accepted summary once and contains none of the forbidden fields represented by rejected fixtures.

expectations.name: deletion
expectations.requirement: Deletion removes the summary, its aggregate contribution, and its export representation.

expectations.name: retention
expectations.requirement: Retention removes only expired rows and recomputes aggregate counts and freshness.

expectations.name: token_revocation
expectations.requirement: Token revocation prevents new ingest while authenticated export and deletion continue to control existing rows.

expectations.name: aggregate_reconciliation
expectations.requirement: Aggregate counts and freshness reconcile with the accepted canary local Board projection.
